description: B3 circuit breaker after Ibovespa fell 10%: cash equities, options and private fixed income halted 30 min, reopened by auction 10:30-10:35 BRT. Intraday low about -17% (170,461) near 10:46
Tesouro Nacional extraordinary buybacks of about R$ 14.8 bn: NTN-F (R$ 7.1 bn) and NTN-B (R$ 7.7 bn, NTN-B 2035 bought at 7.72%); settled 27/10
Tesouro cancels the week's NTN-B and fixed-rate auctions
